subject.title: fix(clickclack): recover when API requests stall

question: Are the proposed 30-second REST header/body-idle budgets and separate 120-second upload budget the intended operational contract for supported self-hosted ClickClack servers?
rationale: The code has no discrete correctness defect, but selecting timeout budgets changes how existing slow or stalled deployments fail and requires owner judgment about the supported service envelope.

options.title: Accept the bounded recovery contract
options.body: Merge the PR with the stated 30-second control-plane/body-idle limits and 120-second upload allowance.

options.title: Adjust documented timeout budgets
options.body: Ask for revised constants and matching proof if supported deployments need a different response or upload window.

recommendation.title: Accept the bounded recovery contract
recommendation.body: Merge the PR with the stated 30-second control-plane/body-idle limits and 120-second upload allowance.

likelyOwner.reason: Likely adjacent owner for the bundled ClickClack channel and its operational behavior.
